promptEs: En 12/8 ya hay una blanca con puntillo. ¿Qué figura completa el compás?
explanationEs: En 12/8 entran doce corcheas, que son dos blancas con puntillo de seis corcheas cada una. Si ya hay una, falta la segunda blanca con puntillo.
promptEn: In 12/8 there is already a dotted half note. Which note value completes the measure?
explanationEn: Twelve eighth notes fit in 12/8, which is two dotted half notes of six eighth notes each. If there is already one, the second dotted half note is missing.
